rows.question: Until what time can I order express delivery?
Who pays the postage when I return something, and how many days do I have?
rows.answer: Unused products may be returned within 60 days of delivery for a full refund [1]. The customer pays the return postage unless the item is faulty or we sent the wrong item [1]. Refunds reach the original payment method within 7 working days after we receive the parcel [1].

rows.question: How do the warranty periods for tents and water purifiers compare?
rows.answer: Tents carry a five-year warranty, while water purifiers carry a two-year warranty [1].

rows.question: How much parental leave do the primary and the secondary carer get?
rows.answer: The primary carer of a new child receives 22 weeks of fully paid parental leave [1]. The secondary carer receives 8 weeks of fully paid leave, which may be taken in up to two blocks during the first year [1].
